Hi Lena (and procurement),

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so the internal teams have alignment and we don't lose momentum: 

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for inference at scale for BrightEdge's summarization pipeline (users: search QA + daily digest).
- Success metrics: 50ms p95 for 256-token responses, cost target under $0.002/token at target throughput, and end-to-end regression <2% vs current baseline.
- Scope for pilot: 2 models (one base + one distilled), traffic mirror of 5k queries/day, up to 3 weeks.
- Data handling: VPC-private deployment preferred; we discussed KMS integration and audit logs.

Action items we agreed:
1) I will send a draft SOW and a ballpark cost range for the pilot by end of next week.
2) Procurement to share any required contract templates / preferred terms.
3) Technical contact: Monica will follow up on API keys, sample payloads, and minimal test dataset.

No surprises from our side. If I missed anything or you want this framed differently for your stakeholders, reply and I'll adjust.

Best,
